Entire people or animals, every target object and supporting furniture fully in frame with generous white margins on all sides, composition at most 75 percent of canvas. One action in one instant, no sequence or collage. Only essential support. Friendly school material. Absolutely NO text, letters, numerals, brands, logos, watermark, arrows or speech bubbles, including clothing and books. Humans wear ordinary clothes. Hands/paws make clear functional contact. Mandatory age mapping: NEN/NENA are children aged 7; NOI/NOIA are tall teenagers aged 17; DONA/HOME are adults aged 40. Include feet, full furniture legs and all objects, scale the whole composition to the central 65 percent, leave at least a 12 percent empty white border on all FOUR sides. Wide distant view, never crop.
